name: Dust Mummy
flavour: Slow. Very, very slow. Still coming.
art_prompt: a goofy stocky mummy wrapped head to toe in loose sandy bandages with a few strips trailing off, thick arms held out in front, two glowing yellow eyes peeking through the wraps and a small crooked grin
motion: shuffling forward in place with stiff heavy steps, arms held out
doc: The wall: slow, thick, fourteen damage a touch. It arrives when a build must have area damage or a way around.
